style_basis: Execution within the flat-vector IGS 2.5D style charter; no penalty for not being painterly, photorealistic or 3D.

criteria.name: Hook & retention
criteria.notes: The opening asks a direct patient-choice question over a large hand and recorder; the visible waiting control creates an immediate unresolved mechanism. The payoff arrives late but clearly when the machine stops and care remains. The automated hook windows pass, though the early announcement section contains several quieter held stretches.

criteria.name: Illustration craft & detail
criteria.notes: The flat-vector house style is consistently finished with ink, form shading, contact shadows, window light, papers, reels, controls and small material details. Props and characters are at broadly similar finish. Several scenes reuse the same clinic-room architecture and sparse pale field, keeping this below exceptional density.

criteria.name: Motion & animation craft
criteria.notes: The 38 true eight-frame strips show meaningful lever travel, hand anticipation, paper movement, room entrances, card transfers, recorder braking and choice-state changes, plus subtler character life. Some strips show only slight movement across eight frames, and 11 graded two-second windows remain under the three-region living-screen target despite the aggregate pass.

criteria.name: Composition & staging
criteria.notes: The 25-frame sheet has a consistent top headline, central action, evidence label and caption-band hierarchy. Both 9:16 and center-cropped square frames are balanced and unclipped. A few split-room and small-document labels approach the lower end of comfortable phone reading.

criteria.name: Color & grade
criteria.notes: Mint, cream, deep green and apricot create a cohesive clinic-document palette with warm/cool separation, light shafts, shadows and a restrained finish. The world suits a healthcare notice but remains deliberately narrow and visually similar across most shots.

criteria.name: Typography & captions
criteria.notes: Headlines, evidence labels and open captions remain high-contrast and readable in the 390px inspection; the normalized 271-word caption gate passes with 44 cues and zero text mismatches. The type system is disciplined, though supporting labels in dense miniature compositions are small.

criteria.name: Sound design & mix
criteria.notes: Objective evidence shows -14.84 LUFS, -2.55 dBTP, LRA 6.1, sourced and credited music, 38 scheduled effects across all shots, 29 verified audible lifts, and a measured 6.1 dB silence dip. This is report-based scoring only; no human listening is claimed, so subjective timbre and exact perceptual balance are not elevated further.

criteria.name: VO–illustration sync & entertainment
criteria.notes: The picture follows the narration's causal sequence: permission, draft, provider control, recording versus note, possible reuse, evidence limit, retention question, refusal and preserved care. The strongest actions land on the spoken ideas, but repeated room/tableau layouts and several restrained holds keep it from feeling continuously surprising.

criteria.name: Accuracy & sourcing
criteria.notes: Fourteen propositions are scoped to two primary TCC pages, with policy and benefit language attributed, recording separated from approved notes and de-identified portions, and the absence of measured outcomes limited to the notice. Illustration labels repeatedly distinguish TCC terms from audit or measured result. The story relies mainly on the announcing institution rather than independent outcome evidence, but says so directly.

criteria.name: Alaska authenticity & cultural respect
criteria.notes: The film names Tanana Chiefs Conference accurately as an Interior Alaska tribal health organization, avoids generic Native iconography and savior framing, and centers patient choice without treating the institution as suspect. The setting is locally grounded but visually generalized rather than culturally specific.

criteria.name: Writing & post quality
criteria.notes: The VO and post are unusually clear about announced aims versus outcomes, permission versus refusal, and the unanswered retention question. The 1714-character post passes its objective rubric, opens inside 68 characters, uses four relevant hashtags and closes with a substantive audience question.

weakest_criterion_note: The aggregate living-screen gate passes, but several eight-frame action windows remain subtle at delivery scale.
one_sentence_fix: Increase silhouette-readable travel and settle in the provider acknowledgement and recording-branch beats so their actions read as decisively as the lever brake and room transformations.

evidence_examined.motion_strip_method: Every filmstrip_*.jpg was viewed; each supplied strip contains eight actual frames and reports its centered time plus first-to-eighth-frame pixel change.

mobile_legibility.method: Six frames decoded directly from the exact square export and scaled to 390x390 in a temporary directory.
mobile_legibility.result: Main headlines, claim labels, captions and credits readable; miniature supporting labels in dense split-room compositions are near the comfortable lower limit.

No human listening was performed. Sound scoring uses delivered encoded-mix measurements, SFX-lift evidence, credits and automated transcription; subjective timbre, performance and moment-to-moment balance are not claimed verified.
Visual inspection covers all 25 contact-sheet frames, all 38 supplied eight-frame strips, and six exact-export 390px square samples, not continuous human playback of every frame.

The 4:5 safe-area claim is supported by the centered square export and current framing evidence; no separate 4:5 export was supplied.
